title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Coventry, West Midlands, CV3 2 RQ
Salary: Competitive, DOE
Contract: Permanent, Part Time - 3 days per week

Benefits:
- Competitive salary
- Contributory pension scheme
- Life cover
- Incapacity benefits
- Cash Back Medical Scheme

About the Company:

We are an innovative medical devices manufacturer of advanced wound care products, including combination products, from gelling fibres and fabrics. We deliver innovative, cost effective and quality products and solutions for the advanced wound care industry helping to improve patient care and wellbeing.

About the Role:

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic individual to join our team as an Accounts Assistant. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting and overseeing systems for day to day processing of financial transactions, processing those transactions in a timely manner operating appropriate controls and making recommendations for improvements in processing and controls.

Duties to include:
- Responsible for ensuring the timely and accurate processing of all day-to-day transactions within the Sales ledger as well as operating all required controls in this area.
- Facilitating on time collection of debt from customers.
- Responsible for ensuring the timely and accurate processing of all day-to-day transactions within the Purchase ledger as well as operating all required controls in this area.
- Proposing payment run of suppliers for management approval.
- Responsible for ensuring timely and accurate processing of all day-to-day transactions relating to cash, company credit card, expenses and journals as well as operating all required controls in these areas.
- Increasing automation within finance and improve finance processes using latest technology available.
- Maintain and update appropriate documentation of process flow and specific procedures including control mechanisms to ensure smooth audit.
- Recommend improvements to procedures, controls, process flows and mandates to the Finance Director for their authorisation and deliver the improvement, updating those procedures and process flows where necessary.

Key skills / abilities:
- Relevant Financial Qualification or QBE.
- Familiarity with double entry accounting is essential.
- Prior experience of an ERP accounting software is essential.
- Being able to successfully identify and deliver process improvements, efficiencies or cost savings is essential.
- Familiarity with accounting techniques employed in a multiproduct environment is beneficial.
- Intermediate level of IT skills including Word, Excel, Outlook and Power Point is essential.
- Good communication skills, with the ability to translate financial requirements to staff are essential.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team is essential.
- Good organisation skills and being adept at leaving a good audit trail is essential.
- Proactive attitude to time management and prioritisation and ability to work to tight deadlines under pressure is essential.
- Experience of working within a Quality / Compliance environment is beneficial.
- Ability to get on with and influence people internally to achieve objectives is beneficial.

Important Information:

Due to the number of applications we receive, we will only contact those candidates that we want to take forward to interview; if you do not hear from us within 4 weeks, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

If you have the skills and experience we require for this role and are looking for a new challenge, please click on APPLY Today and forward an up-to-date CV and cover letter, explaining why you are a good fit for this role.

No Agencies please!

title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
HR & Recruitment Coordinator Care Sector Coventry - on site £26.3 K Full Time Permanent

Gleeson Recruitment Group are working with a fantastic organisation who are looking for an HR Coordinator to join their team in Coventry. This is a great opportunity for an organised and proactive HR professional who enjoys working in a busy environment and wants a role with genuine variety across HR administration, recruitment and employee support.

The Role

Working closely with the HR team, you'll provide end-to-end administrative support across the employee lifecycle, with a particular focus on recruitment and maintaining accurate personnel records.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing high-volume recruitment administration from application through to appointment and induction
- Advertising vacancies and coordinating shortlisting and interview processes
- Preparing interview packs, schedules and recruitment documentation
- Supporting managers with recruitment activity and recruitment events
- Producing offer letters and contracts and processing contractual changes
- Coordinating pre-employment and safer recruitment checks, including references, DBS and employment history
- Maintaining accurate employee records, personnel files and probation information
- Supporting sickness absence and Return-to-Work administration
- Responding to HR queries professionally and confidentially
- Maintaining recruitment trackers, spreadsheets and HR records
- Supporting wider HR and office administration when required

About You

We're looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

You'll ideally have:
- At least one year's office-based administration experience
- Some previous HR administration or recruitment experience
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills
- Experience handling confidential information
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word and Excel
- The confidence to work independently and use your own initiative
- A professional, friendly and adaptable approach
- Ideally, CIPD Level 3 or an HR/Admin qualification

Why this role?

This is a fantastic opportunity for an HR Administrator/HR Assistant looking to develop their career within a supportive HR team. The role offers exposure across recruitment, HR administration, employee records and wider HR processes, giving you the opportunity to build strong, well-rounded HR experience.

Please note: this role is subject to an enhanced DBS check and medical clearance and requires flexibility to work across the organisation's Coventry and Birmingham sites when required.

To apply for the position, please click on the apply now button and your CV will be sent directly to the responsible recruiter. We will respond to successful applicants within 7 days, however please feel free to get in touch if you would like any further information about your application.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Part Time Website Content Coordinator
description:
Website Content Coordinator

Location: Coventry CV4 and home working

Salary: £17,000 to £18,900 pro rata actual (Up to £33,000 FTE)

Hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week flexible

Contract: 9-month fixed-term contract

Benefits: Excellent holiday entitlement, contributory pension scheme, onsite parking and employee assistance programme

We are working on behalf of esteemed organisation, who are recruiting a creative and user-focused Website Content Coordinator to support one of the organisation's most significant digital transformation projects. This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in reviewing, rewriting and creating engaging website content that ensures their audience can find information quickly, access services easily and connect with everything the organisation has to offer.

As Website Content Coordinator, you will work in a small Communications & Marketing team, reporting into the Communications & Marketing Coordinator and working closely with the Communications & Marketing Director. You will also collaborate with colleagues across the organisation and the website project team to ensure content is clear, accessible, accurate and aligned with user needs, research insights and Warwick SU's brand.

The role is part-time at 20 hours per week. There are no fixed working days: the employer is happy to be flexible depending on the successful candidate and their needs, including considering shorter working days across the week. The business has a hybrid working policy with flexibility to work from home dependent on operational requirements.

This is a 9-month fixed-term contract based on the budget currently available for this project role.

Role and responsibilities:
- As a Website Content Coordinator, you will lead the audit, review and redevelopment of website content across the organisation, ensuring content is relevant, engaging and meets user needs.
- Write, edit and proofread high-quality website copy that reflects the organisations tone of voice, brand values and accessibility standards.
- Work closely with colleagues across the organisation to gather information, understand services and translate complex information into clear, student-friendly content.
- Apply user research, content strategy and digital best practice to improve website usability, navigation and overall user experience.
- Collaborate with the website project team to ensure content aligns with the new website structure, design, user journeys and project milestones.
- Support content migration, quality assurance and population of the new website using the content management system.
- Contribute to content governance processes, editorial standards and sustainable workflows that support long-term website maintenance.
- Build positive relationships across departments and help ensure website content remains accurate, relevant and up to date.

Skills and experience required:
- Demonstrable experience writing, editing and proofreading content for websites or other digital channels.
- Experience managing complex content projects involving multiple stakeholders.
- Experience gathering information from subject matter experts and translating it into engaging content for target audiences.
- Experience reviewing and improving content for usability, readability and accessibility.
- Exceptional written communication and copywriting skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across an organisation.
- Understanding of digital content best practice, including accessibility and user-centred content design.
- Proactive, self-motivated and able to work independently, with a curious and analytical approach to understanding user needs.
- Experience of website redevelopment or digital transformation projects and familiarity with content management systems would be advantageous.

Benefits:
- Pro rota holiday entitlement based on 22 days annual leave including Bank Holidays and additional closure days
- Enhanced pension scheme
- Wellbeing programme
- Onsite parking
- BUPA cash plan
- Employee assistance programme

Interviews are scheduled for week commencing 21st and 28th September 2026.

If you are looking for a creative digital content role where you can make an impact, then please apply for this Website Content Coordinator opportunity.

title: People Coordinator
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
Full time People Coordinator role based in Coventry. This role is fully office based.

Client Details

My client is an international education provider based in Coventry who are looking for a People Coordinator.

Description
- Manage recruitment and pre-employment checks, including contracts, references, DBS, right-to-work and qualifications.
- Coordinate end-to-end onboarding for new starters, ensuring documentation, HRIS records and inductions are completed.
- Maintain accurate employee records and process changes such as promotions, salary adjustments, contractual amendments and leavers.
- Support monthly payroll, pensions and benefits by coordinating employee changes and resolving payroll queries.
- Administer probation and employee lifecycle processes, including absence, family leave, flexible working and offboarding.
- Ensure GDPR, safeguarding and employment compliance, while contributing to process improvements and wider People & Culture projects.

Profile
- Previous experience in HR, People Operations or HR Administration.
- Strong understanding of the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, contracts, payroll and records.
- Excellent administrative, organisational and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail.
- Able to handle confidential employee information professionally and accurately.
- Strong communication, stakeholder management and Microsoft Office/HR systems skills.
- Desirable: UK employment law knowledge, education/multi-site experience, payroll experience and CIPD Level 3.
- Can commute to Coventry.

Job Offer
- Negotiable salary depending upon experience
- Free parking
- 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
- Employer pension
- People Coordinator
